description: Inventory from T-003. These build standalone scripts that run under 'set -e' with no provision preamble, so one unverifiable third-party repo aborts the whole action - the same failure that killed provisioning at the mise step: DatabaseEngineInstallScripts (9 call sites), CacheServiceInstallScripts (6), AddEdgeProxyJob (2), CaddyModulesManager (2), DplyCliInstaller (2), SiteFixers (2), InstallFail2banFixAction (2), HttpCacheDaemonInstallScripts (1), InstallServerWebserverJob (1), ControlWorkerDaemonJob (1), PostgresExtensionManager (1). Give them the retry-and-prune behaviour dply_apt_update has, without requiring the preamble: extend AptSourceRepairScript with a self-contained tolerant-update snippet these scripts embed. Do not simply append '|| true' - that hides a genuinely missing package index and the install then fails further along with a worse message.
title: Tolerant apt update in day-two install scripts that run under set -e
